title: Andrew Yang Says AI Boom Is Coming Faster Than Anyone Expects—What We'll See In 'Six Months Outstrips Wha - Benzinga
summary: Tech entrepreneur Andrew Yang discusses the rapid impact of AI on the job market, including disruptions in hiring and the potential need to reevaluate the tax system and social contract due to automation. He also mentions the political response to these changes, including taxation of AI companies.
sentiment_reason: The article presents negative market impact due to concerns about job losses, shifts in the labor market, and the need for potential policy changes in response to automation.
